verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS video platform like Synthesia, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, tracking controls, or privacy settings. The cited items cover video creation, avatars, APIs, webhooks and MCP, none of which is about this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
